svg.title: Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters)
svg.desc: Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters). Domain logic at the core; UIs, databases and queues plug in through ports and adapters. Step 1, In through an adapter: POST /orders reaches the REST controller, which calls the PlaceOrder port; the core runs its rule. Step 2, Out through driven ports: The core calls ports it owns to save, charge and publish; adapters implement them and depend on it. Step 3, Swap and add adapters: Swap SQL for a document store, add a queue consumer on the PlaceOrder port: the core is untouched. Step 4, Test the core on its own: Unplug production, plug in a test driver and in-memory fakes: the rules run in milliseconds.

g.text: 4 · Test the core on its own

The core calls ports it owns to save, charge and publish; adapters implement them and depend on it.

Unplug production, plug in a test driver and in-memory fakes: the rules run in milliseconds.
